### Missing Features

Manual check for missing features via [Genecards](https://www.genecards.org).

```{python}
#| label: missing-Prkn
#| eval: false

np.isin(
    ["Prkn", "PRKN", "AR-JP", "PARK2", "PDJ", "Parkin", "PARKIN"], adata_nafld.var_names
)
```

Not feasible for all symbols.
Use [HGNC](https://www.genenames.org) API to retrieve aliases.

```{python}
#| label: function-get-aliases

def get_aliases(symbol: str, aliases: dict):
  uri = f"https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/symbol/{symbol}"
  res = requests.get(uri, headers={"Accept": "application/json"})
  docs = res.json()["response"]["docs"]

  if res.ok and docs:
    aliases[symbol] = docs[0]["alias_symbol"]
  else:
    aliases[symbol] = False

  return aliases
```

```{python}
#| label: get-aliases-StSt

aliases_StSt = {}
for symbol in features_not_StSt:
    aliases_StSt = get_aliases(symbol, aliases=aliases_StSt)

aliases_StSt
```

```{python}
#| label: get-aliases-NAFLD

aliases_NAFLD = {}
for symbol in not_found_nafld:
    aliases_NAFLD = get_aliases(symbol, aliases=aliases_NAFLD)

aliases_NAFLD
```

```{python}
#| label: reduce-StSt

found_markers_stst = [x for x in features_ST.gene_name if x not in features_not_StSt]
spatial_stst = adata_ST[:, adata_ST.var_names.isin(found_markers_stst)]
reduced_stst = adata_stst[:, adata_stst.var_names.isin(found_markers_stst)]

reduced_stst
```

```{python}
#| label: function-sparse-median

def sparse_median(X, axis=0):
    # Convert sparse format for better performance
    if axis == 0:
        if not sp.isspmatrix_csc(X):
            X = X.tocsc()
    else:
        if not sp.isspmatrix_csr(X):
            X = X.tocsr()

    # Get matrix dimensions
    n_rows, n_cols = X.shape
    size = n_rows if axis == 0 else n_cols

    # Prepare output array
    medians = np.zeros(n_cols if axis == 0 else n_rows)

    # For each column (or row)
    for i in range(medians.shape[0]):
        # Get the slice (column or row)
        if axis == 0:
            data = X[:, i].toarray().flatten()
        else:
            data = X[i, :].toarray().flatten()

        # Count zeros (they're not stored in sparse matrix)
        n_zeros = size - len(data[data != 0])

        # Add zeros back
        if n_zeros > 0:
            data = np.append(data, np.zeros(n_zeros))

        # Calculate median
        medians[i] = np.median(data)

    return medians
```

Only for steady state since we cant compare signal from different disease states with each other and also not with healty cells.

```{python}
#| label: calc-stat-StSt

mean_stst = np.asarray(reduced_stst.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
median_stst = sparse_median(reduced_stst.X, axis=0)
```

```{python}
#| label: calc-stat-healthy-ST

healthy_spatial = spatial_stst[spatial_stst.obs["condition"] == "healthy"]

mean_spatial = np.asarray(healthy_spatial.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
median_spatial = sparse_median(healthy_spatial.X, axis=0)
```

```{python}
#| label: create-expr-df

expr_dist_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "gene": healthy_spatial.var_names,
        "mean_expr_StSt": mean_stst,
        "mean_expr_ST": mean_spatial,
        "median_expr_StSt": median_stst,
        "median_expr_ST": median_spatial
    }
)

expr_dist_df.to_feather(os.path.join(out_dir, "pdata_expr_dist.feather"))
```

```{python}
#| label: plot-mean-expr

sns.scatterplot(data=expr_dist_df, x="mean_expr_StSt", y="mean_expr_ST")
plt.plot(
    [0, max(expr_dist_df.mean_expr_StSt.max(), expr_dist_df.mean_expr_ST.max())],
    [0, max(expr_dist_df.mean_expr_StSt.max(), expr_dist_df.mean_expr_ST.max())],
    ls="--",
    color="gray",
)  # identity line
plt.xlabel("Mean Expression StSt")
plt.ylabel("Mean Expression ST")
plt.title("Gene-wise Expression Comparison")
plt.savefig(os.path.join(out_dir, "mean_expr_comp_StSt.png"))
plt.show()
```
